matched_pair_S5_13.interpretation_scope: One deterministic matched-pair MEASUREMENT of a modeled attack profile.  Not a statistical result, not an equilibrium analysis, and NOT evidence of incentive compatibility, fairness, Sybil resistance, selfish-mining resistance, coalition resistance, common-prefix security, chain-quality security or PoW-equivalent security.  Not the confirmatory experiment matrix.

provenance: every value below is produced by executing the Stage-5 model

A_honest_baseline_disabled.description: All Stage-5 features DISABLED: the frozen Stage-4C behaviour, unchanged.

B_honest_with_incentives.description: Honest miners, incentive layer ON: the reward baseline for every comparison.

C_free_rider.description: One RATIONAL FREE_RIDER at work_fraction 0.5: the physical rate really drops.

D_hash_rate_misreporter.description: One RATIONAL HASH_RATE_MISREPORTER at 3x: reported diverges, physical does not.

E_false_exhaustion_detected.description: FALSE_EXHAUSTION_CLAIMER, modeled audit p=1.0: every claim caught and rejected.

F_false_exhaustion_undetected.description: FALSE_EXHAUSTION_CLAIMER, modeled audit p=0.0: an accepted coverage gap.

G_solution_withholding_never.description: All four miners SOLUTION_WITHHOLDER / NEVER_RELEASE: no block is ever accepted.

H_solution_withholding_delayed.description: All four SOLUTION_WITHHOLDER / DELAYED_RELEASE 2.0s: released and re-accepted.

I_delayed_wake.description: DELAYED_WAKE +5.0s: extra WAKING residency, charged at P_wake (a COST).

J_out_of_range_actor.description: OUT_OF_RANGE_ACTOR: every attempt rejected, penalty-eligible, never credited.

K_assignment_split_and_identities.description: ASSIGNMENT_SPLITTER x4 with 3 declared identities: dedup vs naive accounting.

L_all_adversarial_q_adv_one.description: Every miner BYZANTINE: q_adv == 1.0 over every ACTIVE interval, NA elsewhere.

M_progress_withholding_reassignment.description: S5A-1/2 END-TO-END: an undetected under-report lowers only the ACCEPTED frontier; the physical frontier never rewinds and the re-evaluation earns no second work reward.

N_reported_rate_allocation.description: S5A-3: reported-rate SIZING changes ranges deterministically; physical hash capacity still uses the actual rate.

O_executable_split_and_identities.description: S5A-4: real subassignments under ONE entity capacity budget plus declared virtual identities that grant no physical capacity.

P_executed_abandonment.description: S5A-5: an ABANDONMENT_PENALTY is charged strictly against an EXECUTED abandonment action.

scope.fixed_target: No Stage-5 parameter changes the fixed SHA-256 target or difficulty; dynamic difficulty remains excluded.
scope.nonce_partitioning: Nonce-domain partitioning alone is NOT an energy-saving mechanism and is never described as one.
scope.what_this_is: Deterministic micro-scenario MEASUREMENTS of bounded modeled adversarial behaviours running on the accepted Stage-4C PoCol core.
scope.what_this_is_not: NOT the confirmatory experiment matrix, NOT a statistical result, and NOT evidence of incentive compatibility, fairness, Sybil resistance, selfish-mining resistance, coalition resistance, common-prefix security, chain-quality security or Bitcoin/PoW-equivalent security.  Stage 5 models bounded behaviours and measures outcomes; it does not prove PoCol defeats them.
